I've saved a note for #central-team that the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is due 25 August, as Pree said, and replied to her in a thread on her message.

In that reply I asked her to confirm the date. Today is 14 October 2026, so 25 August has already passed. She may have meant next August or a different date. I couldn't check it against anything because I can't see any Tansley Parcel account files in the share. The note says the year wasn't clear.
